newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian Serb army headquarters moved.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian Serb army headquarters moved.

text.p: Bosnian Serb President Biljana Plavsic on Friday decided to move the headquarters of the Bosnian Serb army to the northeast town of Bjeljina.
The headquarters were situated in the eastern town of Han Pijesak throughout the 43-month old war in Bosnia.
"The chief of general staff will regulate the deployment of all units of the general staff," an announcement said.
No immediate reason was given for the move, which must be implemented by December 1.
Han Pijesak is the headquarters of the sacked Bosnian Serb army commander General Ratko Mladic.
Plavsic has dismissed Mladic and scores of his generals but they are refusing to obey her order.
